notes: New: Calculate in canvas notes. Draw a loop around a handwritten formula, and Professor Euler shows what it read and the answer: arithmetic, fractions, powers, roots, sin, cos, tan, logarithms and equations in one unknown. A small model reads your writing on this computer: no AI provider, no API key, no AI credit, and nothing you write is sent anywhere. Turn it on in Settings > Reading & focus; the model (about 8 MB) is downloaded once.
